findings.title: Appendix RATN full-model Bayes factor '431,034x' reproduces as 418,304x (~3% low)
findings.evidence: Paper: data '431,034 times less likely' under full 3-way RATN model than null. Reimplementation (same BayesFactor::anovaBF, same data, same seed 12604, 1/bf_full) gives 418,303.8 (3.0% lower). The author's own rendered notebook (analysis.nb.html, 1/bf.anova.RATN[18]) gives a THIRD value, 430,597 +/-6.69%. Three MC draws (paper 431,034; notebook 430,597+/-6.69%; this audit 418,304) differing by up to ~3-6% confirms this is pure Monte-Carlo sampling noise in BayesFactor at BF~1e5.
findings.impact: Appendix only, non-preregistered, conclusion (overwhelming support against RATN 3-way interaction) unchanged.
findings.fix: Report to 2 significant figures or note ~2-3% MC error at this magnitude.

findings.title: Appendix RATN '39 times' three-way ratio reproduces as 37.77x
findings.evidence: Paper: full vs no-three-way model '39 times less likely'. Reimpl: inverse of BF ratio = 37.77 (paper 39; 1.5% low). Same MC-noise source as ADV-001.
findings.fix: Round to ~38 or note MC error.

findings.title: Behavioral Table 1 computed on N=36 (includes excluded subject 8), not the stated analytic N=35
findings.evidence: Author's exclusion filter `filter(!subject_id %in% c(8,21,11,23,25,40))` where subject_id is a ZERO-PADDED string ('08','11',...) fails to exclude subject 8: R coerces 8->'8', which never equals '08'. Verified: author-style filter removes {11,21,23,25,40} but keeps 8 (N=36); proper integer filter removes all 6 (N=35). Paper's Table 1 (93.3/88.2/84.5/69.1) equals the 36-subject computation, confirming it includes excluded subject 8. Intended 35-subject values are 93.43/88.19/84.29/69.29.
findings.impact: The reported Table 1 numbers reproduce exactly from the shipped code, but the behavioral analysis sample differs from the stated analytic N=35 and includes a participant the Methods says was removed (technical problems). Numeric impact tiny (0.1-0.2 pts); does not change the qualitative conclusion (accuracy consistent with Patel). Raises a sample-consistency/provenance issue.
findings.fix: In the exclusion filter, convert subject_id to integer (as.integer(subject_id)) before %in%, or store IDs without leading zeros, so excluded subject 8 is dropped from the behavioral analysis too. Recompute Table 1 on N=35.

findings.title: RATN/N350 appendix analysis was not pre-registered
findings.evidence: Appendix explicitly states it was added 'in response to a reviewer's request' and was not pre-registered.
findings.impact: Exploratory add-on; does not affect the pre-registered headline P600 conclusion. Transparently disclosed.
findings.fix: Label the appendix analysis as exploratory/post-hoc in the main text.
